verdict.rationale: Licensing terms are a fair question for a local model runtime, but nothing in the evidence says whether commercial or enterprise use of Ollama needs a paid license or subscription. The pricing-page item ('Run multiple models concurrently') and the cloud-capacity claims describe features and usage tiers, not licensing terms. No license (for example, open-source terms) is named for the community edition.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
